description: K8s advanced patterns decomposed. Operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder), CRD validation + conversion, admission webhooks (mutating, validating), aggregated API server, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL). The mechanisms by which K8s is extended for complex workloads.

sub_mechanisms.name: controller_runtime_library
sub_mechanisms.definition: Go library for K8s controllers. Watch/queue/reconcile loop. Used by kubebuilder.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard controller framework. Handles caching, leader election, event filtering. Don't reimplement.

sub_mechanisms.name: kubebuilder_scaffolding
sub_mechanisms.definition: Code generation for operators. CRD types → Go structs + manifests + reconciler skeleton.
sub_mechanisms.why: Idiomatic operator structure. Eliminates boilerplate. Standard for Go operators.

sub_mechanisms.name: CRD_validation_openAPI
sub_mechanisms.definition: CRD spec schema in OpenAPI v3. Apiserver validates on create/update.
sub_mechanisms.why: Reject invalid resources early. CEL expressions for cross-field validation. Eliminates custom admission webhook for simple validations.

sub_mechanisms.name: CRD_conversion_webhook
sub_mechanisms.definition: Convert between CRD versions (v1alpha1 ↔ v1beta1 ↔ v1). Apiserver calls webhook.
sub_mechanisms.why: Schema evolution. Old + new clients coexist. Required when CRD has incompatible changes.

sub_mechanisms.name: mutating_admission_webhook
sub_mechanisms.definition: HTTP endpoint apiserver calls before persisting. Returns JSON patch to modify object.
sub_mechanisms.why: Auto-inject sidecars (Istio), set defaults, apply policies. Powerful but error-prone (webhook down → API down).

sub_mechanisms.name: validating_admission_webhook
sub_mechanisms.definition: Endpoint apiserver calls; returns allow/deny. No mutation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Policy enforcement (OPA Gatekeeper). Reject non-compliant resources. Failed webhook can block entire API.

sub_mechanisms.name: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy_CEL
sub_mechanisms.definition: K8s 1.30+: in-cluster admission policies via CEL expressions. No webhook needed.
sub_mechanisms.why: Faster than webhook (no network), no separate deployment. Replaces simple OPA policies. Modern preferred.

sub_mechanisms.name: leader_election_in_controller
sub_mechanisms.definition: Multiple replicas of controller; only leader reconciles. Lease-based election.
sub_mechanisms.why: HA: backup ready if leader fails. Avoids dual-reconcile races. controller-runtime supports out of box.

sub_mechanisms.name: finalizer_pattern
sub_mechanisms.definition: Finalizer on resource: blocks deletion until controller cleans up + removes finalizer.
sub_mechanisms.why: External cleanup before resource gone. Operator pattern: delete K8s object → finalizer → cleanup cloud resource → finalizer removed → K8s object gone.

sub_mechanisms.name: owner_references_GC
sub_mechanisms.definition: Resource references its owner. Owner deleted → K8s garbage collects.
sub_mechanisms.why: Deployment → ReplicaSet → Pod cascade. Custom operators set OwnerRef on managed resources. Auto-cleanup.

sub_mechanisms.name: informer_cache
sub_mechanisms.definition: Client-side cache + watch on apiserver. Controllers read from cache, not apiserver.
sub_mechanisms.why: Avoid hammering apiserver. Watch keeps cache fresh. controller-runtime + client-go handle. Critical for controller performance.

sub_mechanisms.name: aggregated_API_server
sub_mechanisms.definition: Custom API server that K8s aggregates into main API. Provides /apis/<group>/v1/...
sub_mechanisms.why: More flexible than CRDs: arbitrary handlers, validation, sub-resources. metrics-server uses. Used when CRDs insufficient.

derivation_rules.name: operator_pattern_for_stateful_complexity
derivation_rules.why: Helm: declarative install. Operator: ongoing reconciliation, failure handling, version upgrade automation. Postgres, Kafka, Prometheus operators exemplify.

derivation_rules.name: CRD_validation_cheaper_than_webhook
derivation_rules.why: Built-in: fast, reliable, no webhook deployment. Webhook: network call per request, can fail. Modern K8s pushes validation into CRD schema.

derivation_rules.name: webhook_failure_blocks_API_operations
if: admission webhook is required for an API operation
derivation_rules.why: failurePolicy=Fail = no webhook reply, no API op. Critical: webhook deployment must be HA + non-circular (don't depend on own resources). Common K8s outage cause.

derivation_rules.name: finalizer_required_for_external_resource_cleanup
then: finalizer required to clean up before K8s deletion
derivation_rules.why: Without: K8s object gone, cloud resource orphaned (cost + clutter). With: K8s blocks deletion; operator deprovisions; removes finalizer; K8s deletes. Standard operator pattern.

derivation_rules.name: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy_replaces_simple_webhooks
derivation_rules.why: No webhook deploy + lifecycle. Runs in apiserver. Faster, more reliable. K8s 1.30+ standard for simple policies. OPA still needed for complex.
